defects.summary: Prior-wave finding (POSIX other-write on a Linux worktree, broad_on_object=2) is SUPERSEDED by the real Windows instrument on this host: the actual deployed surface is the user profile, and the broad-group write ACEs are CodexSandboxUsers:(M,DC) + an unresolved foreign SID, now measured per-target with real icacls text.

NEW measured (owner-action, not repo code): the machine-local group CodexSandboxUsers holds MODIFY on deployed execution-influencing files (settings.json, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, codex config.toml, hooks dispatch.py/manifest.json) - any member of that owner-provisioned sandbox group can rewrite the harness config that gates it. P2 because the group is machine-local and deliberately provisioned for the Codex CLI sandbox integration; remediation (removing the ACEs) is an owner decision that would break that integration. A security-sensitive consumer applying the sshd administrators_authorized_keys precedent WOULD reject these ACLs.

~/.codex/config.toml carries an explicit DENY (W,D,Rc,DC) for the unresolved foreign SID only; the SAME SID retains (M,DC) on the other files. Unresolved-SID ACEs across the profile should be re-audited after account lifecycle changes (owner hygiene item).

report.answer: Measured with REAL icacls on the live deployment of this host: 363/368 deployed execution-influencing targets carry a broad-group MODIFY ACE - the machine-local group CodexSandboxUsers and an unresolved foreign SID - including the highest-influence files (settings.json, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, codex config.toml, hooks dispatch.py + manifest.json). 5 targets are owner/admins/SYSTEM only (['claude-json', 'zcode-agents-md', 'claude-hook:.gitignore', 'claude-hook:CACHEDIR.TAG', 'claude-hook:README.md']). A security-sensitive consumer applying the administrators_authorized_keys precedent WOULD reject the CodexSandboxUsers MODIFY on hook/config files. The empirical non-elevated write limb is honestly NOT-CHECKED (EnableLUA=0; no non-elevated principal exists; both spawned contexts measured elevated).

retry.policy: Retry only with a mechanically different probe. Attempt 1 fingerprint 'runas-trustlevel-silent-failure': runas /trustlevel:0x20000 produced no process; corrected to the explorer-shell-token spawn (mechanically different instrument). Attempt on probe1 fingerprint 'classifier-missed-local-groups': first classifier bucketed unknown machine-local groups as user-or-owner and reported broad_write=0; corrected parser to bucket machine-local groups and unresolved SIDs as broad, verified by the both-states scratch control.

reviewer.notes: Two-round fresh-context review by grok-4.7 (xai) via the local grok2api lane, re-derived from the raw probe JSON (reviewer-packet.txt). ROUND 1 returned FAIL correctly rejecting imprecisely-scoped claims (zcode AGENTS.md is clean; the foreign SID is explicitly DENIED on config.toml); the packet was corrected to exactly target-scoped claims and ROUND 2 returned PASS on all verdicts, both rounds verbatim (review-grok-xai.raw.txt, review-grok-xai-r2.raw.txt). Catalog names a cross-vendor Anthropic (opus) refuter; the anthropic rail on this host is a GLM shim (same vendor as the producer) and was NOT used; the openai codex rail is 401-unauthorized; the xai substitution is disclosed here rather than fabricated.
